request: Fix the confirmed bugs in every skill of this repo, cut the tokens each skill loads, and move all non-decision work to Sonnet-tier workers, without changing observable behavior beyond what each task states.

commands.test: cd claude-skills && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests
commands.test_file: for f in {files}; do case "$(basename "$f")" in test_*.py) (cd claude-skills && python3 -m unittest "tests.$(basename "$f" .py)") || exit 1;; esac; done

notes: The plan file is authoritative: implement exactly the plan section for your slice (copy its code blocks verbatim, follow its steps and Run/Expected pairs). The engine's commit commands replace the plan's own git add/git commit steps; use the plan's commit message text as the commit subject. All paths are repo-root relative (the repo root contains claude-skills/); run tests from inside claude-skills/. Never commit anything under docs/superpowers/. Tests write fixtures only under the system temp dir. Python stdlib only; shell must run on macOS bash 3.2.
